2609.22056.title: Predictable Failure in Multi-Hop Retrieval: Score-Distributional Confidence Scoring and Abstention
2609.22056.paper_summary: Multi-hop retrieval failures are not uniformly distributed across queries: they cluster in structurally predictable subpopulations. We prove two results formalizing this structure. First (CWAR Reducibility): confident-failure reduction is achievable if and only if retrieval features carry mutual information about success, a condition satisfied by LLM-judge pipelines but substantially weaker in dense-only settings, explaining the AUC-AC gap between regimes. Second (Feature Regime Complementarity): no single ANN score feature achieves best predictive performance across all failure regimes; the dominant feature differs between datasets (query length on MuSiQue, hop-1 concentration on HoVer), and a constructive witness pair shows each is necessary in one regime and non-contributory in the other. We instantiate these principles in RegimeAbstain, which computes a Retrieval Confidence Score (RCS), a logistic function of up to nine query-ANN structural features, all available without any additional LLM call, and uses it to implement a calibrated abstention policy. We define the Confident-Wrong-Answer Rate (CWAR) metric and evaluate across three multi-hop benchmarks (MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA, HoVer) and two retrieval architectures (LLM-judge and dense-only), covering five failure regimes with CWAR from 14.5% to 62.1%. RCS achieves best or co-best AUC-AC in all five conditions against eight confidence baselines. On MuSiQue (LLM-judge), RCS reduces CWAR from 39.5% to 20.6% at 50% coverage (47.8% relative reduction), with ECE=0.035. A model trained on MuSiQue transfers to 2WikiMultiHopQA with only -0.5pp AUC loss, confirming the domain-agnostic structure of regime features.
2609.22056.paper_summary_zh: 多跳檢索失敗並不是均勻分佈於所有查詢中：它們在結構上可預測的子群中聚集。我們證明了兩個結果來形式化這一結構。首先（CWAR 可約性）：如果且僅如果檢索特徵攜帶有關成功的互信息，則可以實現自信失敗的減少，這一條件在 LLM-judge 管道中得以滿足，但在僅密集的設置中則顯著較弱，這解釋了兩種模式之間的 AUC-AC 差距。第二（特徵模式互補性）：沒有單一的 ANN 分數特徵能在所有失敗模式中實現最佳預測性能；主導特徵在不同數據集之間有所不同（在 MuSiQue 上是查詢長度，在 HoVer 上是 hop-1 集中度），而一對建設性的見證顯示每個特徵在一種模式中是必要的，而在另一種模式中則無貢獻。我們在 RegimeAbstain 中實現這些原則，該系統計算檢索信心分數（RCS），這是一個最多包含九個查詢-ANN 結構特徵的邏輯函數，所有特徵均可在不進行任何額外 LLM 調用的情況下獲得，並利用它來實施經過校準的棄權政策。我們定義了自信錯誤答案率（CWAR）指標，並在三個多跳基準（MuSiQue、2WikiMultiHopQA、HoVer）和兩個檢索架構（LLM-judge 和僅密集）上進行評估，涵蓋了五種失敗模式，CWAR 從 14.5% 到 62.1%。在所有五種條件下，RCS 在八個信心基準中實現了最佳或並列最佳的 AUC-AC。在 MuSiQue（LLM-judge）上，RCS 將 CWAR 從 39.5% 降至 20.6%（50% 覆蓋率，47.8% 相對減少），其 ECE=0.035。訓練於 MuSiQue 的模型在 2WikiMultiHopQA 上轉移僅損失 -0.5pp AUC，確認了模式特徵的領域無關結構。
